acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Wolves family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Greatwolf, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Hunt-Circle Sovereign archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Monumental but anatomical wolf with a deep mane, long scarred muzzle, distinctive broken upper canine, and arena-command posture.

Signature mechanic: Closing Hunt: four breach points contract in sequence while the Greatwolf assigns Grey Wolves to probe, Dire Wolves to pin, the Howler to change tempo, and the Alpha to close the weakest exit.
battlefieldDuty: Tighten an arena-scale hunt circle and assign every lower Wolf form to a readable breach point.
constructionDimensions: Saturated streaming fur, reflective hide, coherent droplets, and visible currents along the legs preserve the solid wolf beneath.
Throat, paw, and scent-mark actions drive narrow pressure flows whose direction matches the family mechanic.
counterplay: Defeat or displace the assigned lower form and escape through its opening before the Greatwolf commits to that breach. Affinity signal: Water drains from the committed shoulder or throat channel after release, exposing the same physical punish window as Normal.
forbiddenTreatments: Amorphous liquid wolf without a structural core
Opaque spray that hides limbs, gaze, or tail alignment
identityInvariants: Every form retains a four-legged lupine skeleton, long muzzle, visible paws, expressive ears, and a readable tail; no form becomes humanoid or wears manufactured armor.
Rank is communicated through chest mass, coat mantle, scars, posture, and pack behavior rather than arbitrary glow or simple scale.
Pack attack direction remains readable through gaze, ear position, tail line, paw placement, and the spacing of companion Wolves.
telegraph: Hackles rise in sequence around the circle and the Greatwolf's broken upper canine points toward the next closing breach.
